card: Adds unit and functional P2P test coverage for CompactSize deserialization values exceeding MAX_SIZE, while refactoring existing non-canonical tests and formatting serialization helpers. Previously, removing the MAX_SIZE boundary check would pass all tests, and non-deterministic hits during transaction fuzzing introduced noise in test coverage tracking. This ensures corrupt oversized message lengths are reliably tested at both the unit and P2P protocol layers. No dependencies.
evidence: PR description: 'Currently there is no test coverage for oversized CompactSize... Removing the check would pass all tests.'

PR description cites coverage noise: 'There is some accidental non-deterministic coverage through tx-deser "fuzzing", which hurts coverage reports, see https://github.com/corecheck/corecheck/pull/219#discussion_r4554170963.'
problem: The check rejecting CompactSize values larger than MAX_SIZE has no deterministic test coverage, so removing the check passes the test suite. Additionally, occasional coverage hits during transaction deserialization fuzzing introduce non-deterministic noise into test coverage tracking.

risk.why: The functional and unit test additions are isolated, and the header edit is purely whitespace and formatting.

scope_notes: Touches src/serialize.h, but solely for mechanical clang-format brace adjustments.
summary: Adds unit and functional P2P tests for CompactSize deserialization exceeding MAX_SIZE. It also modernizes existing non-canonical CompactSize unit tests to use standard test framework matchers and applies minor formatting cleanup to CompactSize helper functions in serialize.h.
